Agent Name: Validation_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent adopted the manager’s incorrect assumption that Colville is the smallest county seat by land area in Washington, instead of identifying the actual smallest (Cathlamet). This led to retrieving and using Colville’s 2020 Census population rather than Cathlamet’s (560), producing an incorrect difference (732,050 vs. the correct 736,455). The later code-formatting issue was incidental and not the cause of the wrong final answer.
